Semantic splitting and chunking of content

summary: FastMCP is a TypeScript framework for quickly building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Typical scenarios: rapid MCP prototyping, LLM-integration endpoints, serverless stateless request handling, multimedia/streaming responses, CLI-based testing/inspection.
